exposure: Implementation of an Early Onset Sepsis (EOS) calculator protocol for chorioamnionitis
cohort: The study participants were infants aged >= 36 weeks gestation who were exposed to maternal clinical chorioamnionitis and admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU).
finding: Implementation of an EOS calculator protocol significantly decreased infant antibiotic exposure without missing any EOS cases, and no correlation was found between EOS calculator-based treatment and placental histopathology.
